title: [Bug] 走 Messages API 的 Claude 回复，用量里的推理 token 恒为 0（aUsage 不读 output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens）
head: fb6763d9f236f71dd7a76fb0c4a4275ac1c89193
rootCause: aUsage in internal/gateway/anthropic.go had no output_tokens_details, so aUsage.usage() never filled Usage.Reasoning: every Claude reply over the Messages API (Anthropic, Copilot, Bedrock, relays) was recorded with reasoning 0, on both the relayed path (sniff.go's usageSniffer) and the translated decoder (decodeAnthropic's message_delta). The reverse direction was missing too: Usage.anthropic() wrote no output_tokens_details, so a Chat/Responses upstream's reasoning reached a Claude client as none.
fix: aUsage gains OutputTokensDetails{ThinkingTokens} read by usage(); Usage.anthropic() writes it back when Reasoning > 0 (output unchanged when 0).
unverifiedBoundaries: No real Copilot/Anthropic/Bedrock reply was tried: the relayed half uses Copilot's real message_delta bytes (text cut) from the issue, the translated half a local Chat SSE.

The reporter's own reference commit (mdwsk88/magpie gateway-anthropic-thinking-tokens 9feac29c6) was not read in full; this is an independent implementation of the same root cause on the current base. Credit mdwsk88 in the public comment.

Not run: /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses client paths against an Anthropic upstream (the issue's reporter tested those too). Both decode aUsage through the same usage() that was fixed, and OpenAI-format usage already carried reasoning_tokens before, but that is reasoning, not a run.
DecodeOf's speed numbers for Messages replies change as a consequence (that is the issue's intent); no test pins an old DecodeOf value for such a reply.
